description: This file defines command-line subcommands for managing a launchd agent, including installing, uninstalling, and checking the status of the agent. It utilizes the Commander library for command parsing and Foundation for file management and plist serialization.

classes.name: ServiceRootCommand
classes.description: Main command grouping for service management commands.

classes.name: ServiceInstall
classes.description: Subcommand to install the launch agent.

classes.name: ServiceUninstall
classes.description: Subcommand to remove the launch agent.

classes.name: ServiceStatus
classes.description: Subcommand to check the status of the launch agent.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes a launchd plist file with specified executable.
